doc.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview

chapter: Riverside and the New York scene
title: Missing the Blakey and Monk date for Atlantic
summary: Drunk, Ware passes out in the studio bathroom and Sam Dockery replaces him.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Well maybe, the one or two occasions when something did happen, brought that attitude on, like the record with Art Blakey, where Spanky played, in Harlem on My Mind the one ... there's a picture of it -- the one with Sam Dockery.

Yeah, that was on Atlantic. Johnny Griffin joined the Messengers, and it was Art Blakey and the Messengers, with Thelonious. Now I was supposed to play on part of it, and the Messengers -- Bill Hardman -- and I was out with Wilbur Campbell, and I got drunk on top of it, too. And we got down to the studio, I go in the bathroom and pass out. See, and whoever the date was, they though Monk was gonna do the same thing, so they had Sam Dockery on a standby basis. So I missed that date.

Well, it's all a part of the game.
